fusions.name: Cave Shriek
fusions.desc: A shrieking hoot in a cone 4.5 tiles long deals 9 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Drop From the Rafters
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. You drop onto it and bite for 20 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hang in the Dark
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Dusk Swinger
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
